crossRefs.note: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and…
For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my…

translations.web: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
translations.bsb: Therefore I am terrified in His presence; when I consider this, I fear Him.
translations.kjv: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid
translations.asv: Therefore am I terrified at his presence; When I consider, I am afraid of him.
